orientation.instructions: Which way is the printed text in `photo` turned?

criteria.upright: The text reads normally, left to right.
criteria.top_points_right: The image is turned so the tops of the letters face the right edge.
criteria.top_points_left: The image is turned so the tops of the letters face the left edge.

shows_vehicle.instructions: Does `photo` show a motor vehicle, such as a truck, tipper, pickup or van?

gps_stamp.instructions: Is a GPS stamp printed on `photo`?

criteria.true: A block of text printed on the photo by a GPS map camera app, with a place name or address, latitude and longitude, and a date and time.
criteria.false: No such block of text, or only a date and time with no place or coordinates.

plate.instructions: How well can the registration number on the vehicle's number plate in `photo` be read?

criteria.not_visible: No number plate of the vehicle is in view.
criteria.partly_readable: A number plate is in view, but some of its letters or digits are hidden, blurred, dirty, cut off or too small to read.
criteria.readable: Every letter and digit on the number plate can be read.

plate_number.instructions: Is the registration number on the vehicle's number plate in `photo` the same as `vehicle_number`? Compare only the letters and digits, ignoring spaces, hyphens, dots, line breaks and letter case. They are the same only if every letter and digit matches, in the same order.

criteria.different: At least one letter or digit on the plate differs from `vehicle_number`, or is missing or extra.
criteria.same: The plate shows the same letters and digits as `vehicle_number`, in the same order.
criteria.cannot_tell: No number plate is in view, or it can't be read well enough to compare.

stamp_hour.instructions: If a GPS stamp is printed on `photo`, what hour is the time in the stamp? Give the hour on a 24-hour clock: 2:15 AM is 02, 2:15 PM is 14, 12:30 AM is 00.

criteria.not_shown: There is no GPS stamp with a time, or its time can't be read.

stamp_minute.instructions: If a GPS stamp is printed on `photo`, what minute is the time in the stamp?

criteria.not_shown: There is no GPS stamp with a time, or its time can't be read.

stamp_day.instructions: If a GPS stamp is printed on `photo`, what day of the month is the date in the stamp?

criteria.not_shown: There is no GPS stamp with a date, or its date can't be read.

stamp_month.instructions: If a GPS stamp is printed on `photo`, what month (01 to 12) is the date in the stamp?

criteria.not_shown: There is no GPS stamp with a date, or its date can't be read.
